label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry

quantities.name: crystals
quantities.definition: barrel crystal volumes in one supermodule of the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: 20 in phi x 85 in eta (detector-atlas:C132, TDR Table 1.2); 'a supermodule holds 1700 crystals' (detector-atlas:C128, 2008); 360 x 170 / 36 = 1700 from the barrel totals (detector-atlas:C124, C128). Four modules of 400 or 500 crystals (C128) can sum to 1700 only as one of 500 (25 eta rows of 20) and three of 400 (20 rows of 20).

independence.result: a design count stated by CMS in two documents (2008 paper and 1997 TDR) and by the barrel totals, not a simulation output; the case checks how the segmentation is expressed (grid, stack), not physics

negative_control.change: one eta row fewer in the 500-crystal module (24 x 20)

approximations: the supermodule is flat: the crystals sit on a rectangular 85 x 20 grid of pitch rear face + 0.35 mm (detector-atlas:C127), not on the pointing, 3-degree off-pointing barrel geometry (C126); every crystal is the nominal 22 x 22 to 26 x 26 x 230 mm3 trd of the S6 case, not the 17 shape pairs
which module holds 500 crystals is not sourced (the order of the modules in eta was not read); the 500-crystal module is placed first
the 4 mm aluminium webs (C128) are flat plates between the modules; the alveolar walls (C127), submodules and the 0.5 mm gaps between submodules are not modelled
aluminium is Geant4's G4_Al; the webs' alloy is not sourced
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
